originality.rationale: The exact sharp n=3 threshold and universal rational negative-derivative witness contradict the numerical cutoffs expressly suggested in Ulas 2019 Conjecture 4.2(1); the general Stern identity and zero-localization literature are acknowledged and do not state the threshold. Relevant published-record and source comparisons found no equivalent statement; an implicit prior derivation remains a risk.
residual_risks: An unindexed or differently titled result could already specialize the classical Stern identity into the same sharp cutoff.
The eventual monotonicity conjecture for each fixed even k is not addressed; only its suggested numerical cutoff is contradicted.
